verse.verse_3: About which they are in disagreement.
verse.verse_4: Nay, they will come to know!
verse.verse_5: Nay, again, they will come to know!
verse.verse_6: Have We not made the earth as a bed,
verse.verse_8: And We have created you in pairs.
verse.verse_9: And We have made your sleep as a thing for rest.
verse.verse_10: And We have made the night as a covering,
verse.verse_11: And We have made the day for livelihood.
verse.verse_12: And We have built above you seven strong,
verse.verse_13: And We have made (therein) a shining lamp.
verse.verse_14: And We have sent down from the Mu`sirat water Thajjaj.
verse.verse_15: That We may produce therewith grains and vegetations,
verse.verse_17: Verily, the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
verse.verse_18: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and you shall come forth in crowds.
verse.verse_19: And the heaven shall be opened, and it will become as gates.
verse.verse_20: And the mountains shall be moved away from their places and they will be as if they were a mirage.
verse.verse_21: Truly, Hell is a place of ambush
verse.verse_22: A dwelling place for the Taghun,
verse.verse_24: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink.
verse.verse_26: An exact recompense (according to their evil crimes).
verse.verse_27: For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning.
verse.verse_28: But they denied Our Ayat Kidhdhaba.
verse.verse_29: And all things We have recorded in a Book.
verse.verse_30: So taste you. No increase shall We give you, except in torment.
verse.verse_31: Verily, for those who have Taqwa, there will be a success;
verse.verse_35: No Laghw shall they hear therein, nor lying;
verse.verse_36: Rewarded from your Lord with a sufficient gift.
verse.verse_37: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Gracious, with Whom th- ey cannot dare to speak.
verse.verse_38: The Day that Ar-Ruh and the angels will stand forth in rows, they will not speak except him whom Ar-Rahman allows, and he will speak what is right.
verse.verse_39: That is the True Day. So, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with His Lord!
verse.verse_40: Verily, We have warned you of a near torment -- the Day when man will see that which his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say: "Woe to me! Would that I were dust!"
